units.source_text: 说我压根儿不愿同母亲会面，也未免太夸大了。

en.t: To say that I had absolutely no wish to see my mother would be too much of an exaggeration.
It was not that I did not miss my mother.

units.source_text: 我只是讨厌当众公开表露对亲人的爱情，也许只有这种讨厌才促使我设法制造种种的借口。

en.t: I simply disliked openly showing my love for my family in front of others, and perhaps that dislike alone drove me to invent all sorts of excuses.
This was a bad trait of mine.

units.source_text: 如果以种种借口可以使正直的感情合法化还好，

en.t: If various excuses could legitimize honest feelings, that would have been all right,

units.source_text: 可是有时候，自己的头脑里编出来的无数的理由，

en.t: but sometimes the countless reasons invented inside my own head

units.source_text: 把连自己意料不到的感情也强加给我自己。

en.t: would force upon me even feelings I myself had never expected.

units.source_text: 这种感情本来就不属于我的。

en.t: Those feelings had never belonged to me in the first place.
